# Study 02, Experiment 1: post-hoc analyses (generated by scripts/s2_analyze.py posthoc)

Everything here was chosen after the results were seen and is exploratory.

## 0.5B: `test_comp` on the same families at every level

For each replicate, test families are split by whether its 25-family training set already contains all of their tools and practised edges. Every level is then scored on those same two groups.

| group (defined at D = 25) | families per replicate | D = 25 | D = 100 | D = 400 | D = 1600 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| covered at D = 25 | 103 | 34.4 | 37.4 | 43.5 | 45.5 |
| not covered at D = 25 | 497 | 15.8 | 26.3 | 31.8 | 36.1 |

Difference D = 1,600 minus D = 25 per replicate, covered group: +9.9, +11.2, +17.7, +9.0, +7.5; not covered: +19.8, +17.3, +18.2, +20.9, +25.3.
